predecessors.name: Czechoslovakia
predecessors.text: the Slovak half of Czechoslovakia: 'The national territory was divided along the existing internal borders'

ledger.x: 1 January 1993: Slovakia becomes an independent state.

certainty.note: The borders follow the former Czechoslovak internal boundary and the older frontiers with Hungary, Poland, Ukraine and Austria; the Czech-Slovak line was settled by the 1996 treaty.
